# ghost Provider

Manage resources on [Ghost](https://web.ghost.procrastinator.fyi), a GitHub alternative.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "ghost" {
  # Or set the GHOST_TOKEN environment variable.
  token = var.ghost_token

  # Optional. Defaults to https://api.ghost.procrastinator.fyi
  # base_url = "https://api.ghost.procrastinator.fyi"
}

variable "ghost_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Ghost API. May also be set with the `GHOST_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `https://api.ghost.procrastinator.fyi`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Ghost personal access token. May also be set with the `GHOST_TOKEN` environment variable.
